how_to_apply: Download the application form from the CSIR-CMERI vacancy page.
Report on 11 November 2026 at 10:00 AM to CSIR-CMERI Centre of Excellence for Farm Machinery, Opp. GNE College, Gill Road, Ludhiana-141006, Punjab.
Appear before the Selection Committee with your documents.
All original certificates and mark sheets
A self-attested photocopy of each certificate and mark sheet

A No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the Competent Authority, if you are currently working in any project at CSIR-CMERI or another CSIR lab or institute. Without it, you will not be allowed to appear for the interview.

content_sections.heading: About CSIR-CMERI CoEFM
content_sections.text: The CSIR-CMERI Centre of Excellence for Farm Machinery was set up in 1965 as an extension centre of the Central Mechanical Engineering Research Institute, Durgapur. It works under the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR), an autonomous body under the Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India. The centre is on Gill Road, Ludhiana, and its current research priority is Smart Farm Machines and Technologies.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected by a walk-in interview before a Selection Committee. They can choose Hindi or English as the language for the interview. The selection process may continue until late evening or into the next day. Candidates who do not meet the eligibility criteria at any stage, during the process or later, will have their candidature cancelled without any reason being given. The decision of CSIR-CMERI on selection is final, and no correspondence will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is for project work in R&D projects at the centre's laboratories, and it is co-terminus with the project. The tenure shown for each post may be extended or curtailed. It lasts until the project ends or the requirement ends, whichever is earlier, and never beyond a maximum of six years. Offers of engagement depend on the availability of funds and approval by the Competent Authority. No TA/DA is paid for attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q1. Where is the CSIR-CMERI CoEFM walk-in interview being held?
faq.answer: At CSIR-CMERI Centre of Excellence for Farm Machinery, Opp. GNE College, Gill Road, Ludhiana-141006, Punjab. Candidates for all four post codes report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Can a diploma holder apply?
faq.answer: Yes, for P704 Project Assistant-II. It needs a 3 years Diploma in Agricultural Engineering or Mechanical Engineering, and working knowledge of CAD is desirable. The pay is Rs. 20000/- per month.

faq.question: Q3. Does a fresh Master's graduate need experience for Project Associate-II?
faq.answer: No. For P701 and for Project Associate-II under P702, a Masters or Integrated Masters in the listed disciplines needs no experience. Bachelor's degree holders need 2 years' R&D experience.

faq.question: Q4. Who gets Rs. 35,000 instead of Rs. 28,000 as Project Associate-II?
faq.answer: Candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC / ICAR / ICMR NET (including lectureship / assistant professorship) or GATE, or a national-level examination conducted by Central Government departments like DBT/DST, get Rs. 35,000 + HRA. Others get Rs. 28,000 + HRA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Senior Project Associate?
faq.answer: 40 years, counted as on the interview date. The other posts have an upper age limit of 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. Will HRA be paid if I stay in the hostel?
faq.answer: No. Fellowship holders living in hostels are not entitled to HRA. It may be allowed as per Central Government norms only where hostel accommodation is not provided.

faq.question: Q7. I am already working on a CSIR project. Can I attend?
faq.answer: Yes, but you must bring a No Objection Certificate from the Competent Authority. Candidates who have already worked 6 years or more in CSIR as a project or research fellow cannot apply.

faq.question: Q8. How long will the engagement last?
faq.answer: Up to 31/03/2028 (extendable) for P701, P702 and P703, and up to 31/03/2027 for P704. In all cases it ends with the project.

faq.question: Q9. Is travel allowance paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can I give the interview in Hindi?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates can choose Hindi or English as the language of communication during the walk-in interview.
